Looking at your code, I can see several potential issues that could cause infinite loops:
Main Issues:
1. Infinite Re-render in $ComponentFunction
typescript
const [cid, setChemicalId] = useState(-1);
// ...
if (newChemical)
    setChemicalId(chemical[$cid]);
This setState call happens during render, which will trigger another render immediately. This is a React anti-pattern that causes infinite loops.
Fix: Move the state update to useEffect:
typescript
const [cid, setChemicalId] = useState(-1);
const initialCid = -1;

let chemical: T;
let newChemical = false;
if (!this.$bound) {
    newChemical = cid === initialCid;
    chemical = newChemical ? this.createChemical() : $chemicalRegistry.get(cid) as T;
    if (!chemical) throw new Error(`$Chemical[${cid}] not found`);
    if (newChemical) {
        $chemicalRegistry.set(chemical[$cid], chemical);
    }
} else {
    chemical = this._chemical!;
}

// Move setState to useEffect
useEffect(() => {
    if (newChemical) {
        setChemicalId(chemical[$cid]);
    }
}, [newChemical, chemical[$cid]]);
2. Circular State Updates in $Bond.bondCall
typescript
private bondCall(chemical: $Chemical, ...args: any[]): any {
    chemical[$formula].bindState();
    // ...
    let result = this._action!(...args);
    chemical[$formula].updateState();  // ← Triggers setState
    chemical[$formula].unbind();
    // ...
}
updateState() calls setState, which triggers a re-render, which could call the bond again if accessed during render.
3. $Formula.updateState() Logging Inside setState
typescript
bindUpdate(setState: (state: string) => void, update: () => any) {
    this._setState = (state: string) => { 
        console.log(`setState:${this._chemical[$cid]}`);  // Side effect
        setState(state); 
    }
    // ...
}

updateState() {
    if (!this._setState)
        throw new Error("The setSetate function has not been bound");
    console.log(this.state);  // ← Accesses bonds, could trigger tracking
    this._setState(this.state); 
    console.log(`setState called: ${this._setState}`)
}
The console.log(this.state) call triggers symbolize(), which accesses bonds, which could mark them as accessed and cause them to be included in state again.
4. child() Method Could Cause Props Thrashing
typescript
child(chemical: $Chemical, props: any): any {
    if (chemical[$lastProps] === props) return props;
    return chemical[$binder].bond(props, this);
}
If bond() modifies props and returns a new object, the referential check will always fail, causing bond() to be called every time.
Recommended Fixes:
typescript
// Fix 1: Don't setState during render
const [cid, setChemicalId] = useState(-1);
const chemicalRef = useRef<T | null>(null);

if (!this.$bound) {
    if (cid === -1) {
        // First render - create chemical
        if (!chemicalRef.current) {
            chemicalRef.current = this.createChemical();
            $chemicalRegistry.set(chemicalRef.current[$cid], chemicalRef.current);
        }
        chemical = chemicalRef.current;
    } else {
        chemical = $chemicalRegistry.get(cid) as T;
        if (!chemical) throw new Error(`$Chemical[${cid}] not found`);
    }
} else {

}

// Update cid in effect, not render
useEffect(() => {
    if (cid === -1 && chemicalRef.current) {
        setChemicalId(chemicalRef.current[$cid]);
    }
}, [cid]);
typescript
// Fix 2: Guard updateState to prevent calling during render
updateState() {
    if (!this._setState) throw new Error("The setState function has not been bound");
    
    // Don't update if we're already destroyed
    if (this._destroyed) return;
    
    // Get state without triggering tracking
    const chemical = this._chemical;
    const wasReactive = chemical[$reactive];
    chemical[$reactive] = false;
    const stateSnapshot = this.state;
    chemical[$reactive] = wasReactive;
    
    this._setState(stateSnapshot);

// Fix 3: Add debouncing to prevent rapid state updates
private _stateUpdateScheduled = false;

update() {
    if (!this._update) throw new Error("The update function has not been bound");
    if (this._stateUpdateScheduled) return;
    
    this._stateUpdateScheduled = true;
    Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        this._stateUpdateScheduled = false;
        this._update!();
    });
}
The most critical fix is #1 - never call setState during the render phase. This is almost certainly what's causing your infinite loop.

The infinite loop chain:

bond() calls process()

The issue is that bond() modifies props (adds/changes children), so the check chemical[$lastProps] === props will always fail on subsequent calls, causing it to call bond() again infinitely.
Fix: Check if props have actually changed in a meaningful way, or break the recursion:
typescript
child(chemical: $Chemical, props: any): any {
    // Prevent re-processing if we're already in a bond operation
    if (chemical[$binder]._isProcessing) return props;
    
    if (chemical[$lastProps] === props) return props;
    props = chemical[$binder].bond(props, this);
    chemical[$lastProps] = props;
    return props;
}
And add a flag to $BondOrchestrator:
typescript
class $BondOrchestrator<T extends $Chemical> {
    private _chemical: T;
    private _bondConstructor?: Function;
    private _parameters: { isArray: boolean, isSpread: boolean }[] = [];
    private _lastProps?: any;
    private _rendered: Map<Function, ReactElement> = new Map();
    private _lastAguments?: $BondArguments;
    private _isProcessing = false;  // ← Add this

    bond(props: any, parentContext?: $BondOrchestrationContext): any {
        if (this._isProcessing) return props;  // ← Add this guard
        
        this._isProcessing = true;  // ← Set flag
        try {
            const chemical = this._chemical;
            // ... rest of your code
            return props;
        } finally {
            this._isProcessing = false;  // ← Clear flag
        }
    }
}
This prevents bond() from being called recursively on the same chemical during processing.

Let me look more carefully at what could cause an infinite loop...
Found it! Look at $BondOrchestrationContext.next():
typescript
next(node: any) {
    const context = this.clone();
    context.node = node;
    
    if (!context.parameter && context.parameterIndex == -1) {
        if (context.parameters && context.parameters.length > 0) {
            context.parameterIndex = 0;
            context.parameter = context.parameters[context.parameterIndex];
        } else {
            context.argsValid = false;
        }
    } else if (context.parameter && context.parameter.isSpread) {
        context.args = context.arguments.values;  // ← PROBLEM
    } else if (context.parameter && !context.parameter.isSpread) {
        context.parameterIndex++;
        // ...
    }
    return context;
}
When you have a spread parameter (...rest), every call to next() keeps reassigning context.args = context.arguments.values, but never advances the parameter. So if you process multiple children with a spread parameter, you're stuck in the spread state forever.
Also in your clone() method:
typescript
private clone(): this {
    const context = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(this));
    Object.assign(context, this);
    return context;
}
This does a shallow copy, so context.args and context.arguments.values are the same array reference across all clones! When one context pushes to args, it affects all contexts.
Fixes:
typescript
private clone(): this {
    const context = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(this));
    Object.assign(context, this);
    // Don't share the same arrays!
    context.arguments = new $BondArguments(this.parameters);
    context.args = context.arguments.values;
    return context;
}
And fix the spread parameter logic - once you're in spread mode, stay there but don't keep reassigning:
typescript
next(node: any) {
    const context = this.clone();
    context.node = node;
    
    if (!context.parameter && context.parameterIndex == -1) {
        if (context.parameters && context.parameters.length > 0) {
            context.parameterIndex = 0;
            context.parameter = context.parameters[context.parameterIndex];
        } else {
            context.argsValid = false;
        }
    } else if (context.parameter && context.parameter.isSpread) {
        // Don't reassign, just keep using the same args array
        // (already set correctly from constructor/clone)
    } else if (context.parameter && !context.parameter.isSpread) {
        // ... rest of logic
    }
    return context;
}
The shared array reference is likely your culprit!

Claude
14:55 UTC, 11 October 2025
Yes! Spread parameters in JavaScript must be the last parameter and collect all remaining arguments.
So when you hit a spread parameter, you should stop advancing through parameters - everything from that point goes into the spread array.
Here's the corrected logic:
typescript
next(node: any) {
    const context = this.clone();
    context.node = node;
    
    if (!context.parameter && context.parameterIndex == -1) {
        // First parameter
        if (context.parameters && context.parameters.length > 0) {
            context.parameterIndex = 0;
            context.parameter = context.parameters[context.parameterIndex];
        } else {
            context.argsValid = false;
        }
    } else if (context.parameter && context.parameter.isSpread) {
        // Already in spread mode - stay there, collect everything
        // Don't reassign args or advance parameter
        // Just keep collecting into the same spread array
    } else if (context.parameter && !context.parameter.isSpread) {
        // Move to next parameter
        context.parameterIndex++;
        if (context.parameters && context.parameterIndex < context.parameters.length) {
            context.parameter = context.parameters[context.parameterIndex];
            if (context.parameter && context.parameter.isSpread) {
                // Entered spread mode - args already points to the right array
            }
        } else {
            // Ran out of parameters
            context.parameter = undefined;
            context.argsValid = false;
        }
    }
    return context;
}
But the critical issue is still the clone() method sharing array references. You need:
typescript
private clone(): this {
    const context = Object.create(Object.getPrototypeOf(this));
    Object.assign(context, this);
    
    // Create new argument tracking for this clone
    context.arguments = new $BondArguments(this.parameters);
    // Copy existing args into new array
    context.arguments.values = [...this.arguments.values];
    context.args = context.arguments.values;
    
    return context;
}
This way each context clone has its own args array that won't interfere with others.

} else if (typeof type === 'function') {

Every time you process a function component:
$(func) creates a new $$Function chemical
This new chemical gets a new cid
So key !== element.key is always true
You push a modified child with the new key
React sees the key changed, unmounts old component, mounts new one
New component renders, processes children again
Loop!
You're creating a new chemical instance every render instead of reusing the existing one!
Fix: You need to cache or reuse the chemical from the element itself:
typescript
} else if (typeof type === 'function') {
    let component: $$Component = type;
    
    // Check if this element already has a bound chemical
    // (e.g., from previous render stored in element.key or registry)
    if (!component.$bind) {
        // It's a plain React.FC - need to wrap it
        // But reuse existing chemical if we've seen this element before
        let func = type as React.FC;
        component = $(func).$Component;
    }
    
    // Only bind if not already bound
    if (!component.$bound) {
        component = component.$bind(this._chemical);
    }

    const chemical = component.$chemical;
    const props = context.child(chemical, element.props);
    const key = element.key || `${chemical[$cid]}`;  // ← Use existing key if present
    context.args.push(chemical);
    
    if (props !== element.props || key !== element.key) {
        context.children.push({ type: component, props: props, key: key });
        context.isModified = true;
    } else {
        context.children.push(element);  // ← Reuse unchanged element
    }
}
The issue is that $(func) creates a brand new $$Function with a new cid every time, so React thinks it's a different component and remounts it infinitely.

Wait, I see it! In processArray():
typescript
private processArray(elements: any[], context: $BondOrchestrationContext) {
    elements.map(item => {
        context.isModified = true;
        context = context.next(item);  // ← Updates context
        if (context.isElement) {
            this.processElement(item as React.ReactElement<any>, context)
        } else if (Array.isArray(item)) {
            context = context.array();  // ← Updates context AGAIN
            this.processArray(item, context);  // ← Recursive call
        } else {
            context.args.push(item);
            context.children.push(item);
        }
    });
}
You do context = context.next(item), then if it's an array, you do context = context.array(). But array() returns a CHILD context (with parent set).
Then when processArray returns, you're back in the parent loop, but context now points to the child context! The next iteration of elements.map() will call next() on the wrong context.
The fix: Don't reassign context when recursing:
typescript
private processArray(elements: any[], context: $BondOrchestrationContext) {
    elements.map(item => {
        context.isModified = true;
        context = context.next(item);
        if (context.isElement) {
            this.processElement(item as React.ReactElement<any>, context)
        } else if (Array.isArray(item)) {
            const arrayContext = context.array();  // ← Don't reassign context
            this.processArray(item, arrayContext);  // ← Use separate variable
        } else {
            context.args.push(item);
            context.children.push(item);
        }
    });
}
That way context stays consistent throughout the loop iterations!

The fix in ␀0␀:
typescript
bond(props: any, parentContext?: $BondOrchestrationContext): any {
    const chemical = this._chemical;
    let children: ReactNode = props.children;
    const context = new $BondOrchestrationContext(chemical, this._parameters);
    parentContext?.childContexts.push(context);
    
    // Early return if props haven't changed
    if (props === this._lastProps) 
        return this._lastProps;
    
    this._rendered = new Map();
    this.bindProps(chemical, props);
    
    this.process(children, context);
    if (context.isModified) {
        children = context.build();
        props = { ...props, children: children };
    }

    chemical[$children] = props.children;
    this._lastProps = props;

    if (this._bondConstructor && context.argsValid) {
        // Only call constructor if arguments actually changed
        if (!this._lastAguments || !$BondArguments.equals(this._lastAguments, context.arguments)) {
            console.log(`Constructor:`, this._bondConstructor?.name, `Args: ${symbolize(context.arguments.values)}`)
            this._bondConstructor!.apply(this._chemical, context.arguments.values);
            this._lastAguments = context.arguments;
        }
        // ← ADD THIS: If args are empty but we had args before, skip the constructor call entirely
        else if (context.arguments.values.length === 0 && this._lastAguments && this._lastAguments.values.length > 0) {
            console.log(`Constructor skipped - empty args when previous had data`);
            // Don't call constructor, keep previous state
        }
    }

    chemical[$formula].refresh();
    return props;
}
Or even simpler - the check should be: "if the new arguments are empty but the last arguments weren't, don't call the constructor at all":
typescript
if (this._bondConstructor && context.argsValid) {
    const newArgs = context.arguments.values;
    const oldArgs = this._lastAguments?.values || [];
    
    // Don't overwrite with empty args
    const isEmptyUpdate = newArgs.length === 0 && oldArgs.length > 0;
    
    if (!isEmptyUpdate && (!this._lastAguments || !$BondArguments.equals(this._lastAguments, context.arguments))) {
        console.log(`Constructor:`, this._bondConstructor?.name, `Args: ${symbolize(newArgs)}`)
        this._bondConstructor!.apply(this._chemical, newArgs);
        this._lastAguments = context.arguments;
    }
}
This way, if a parent re-renders a child without children, the child keeps its previously set constructor arguments!

Check if props.children is undefined or empty:
typescript
bond(props: any, parentContext?: $BondOrchestrationContext): any {
    const chemical = this._chemical;
    
    // Check if props has no children (empty update)
    const hasChildren = props.children !== undefined && 
                       props.children !== null && 
                       (Array.isArray(props.children) ? props.children.length > 0 : true);
    
    let children: ReactNode = props.children;
    const context = new $BondOrchestrationContext(chemical, this._parameters);
    parentContext?.childContexts.push(context);
    
    if (props === this._lastProps) 
        return this._lastProps;
    
    this._rendered = new Map();
    this.bindProps(chemical, props);
    
    this.process(children, context);
    if (context.isModified) {
        children = context.build();
        props = { ...props, children: children };
    }

    chemical[$children] = props.children;
    this._lastProps = props;

    if (this._bondConstructor && context.argsValid) {
        const newArgs = context.arguments.values;
        const oldArgs = this._lastAguments?.values || [];
        
        // Don't call constructor if this is an empty update (no children) but we had children before
        const isEmptyUpdate = !hasChildren && oldArgs.length > 0;
        
        if (!isEmptyUpdate && (!this._lastAguments || !$BondArguments.equals(this._lastAguments, context.arguments))) {
            console.log(`Constructor:`, this._bondConstructor?.name, `Args: ${symbolize(newArgs)}`)
            this._bondConstructor!.apply(this._chemical, newArgs);
            this._lastAguments = context.arguments;
        } else if (isEmptyUpdate) {
            console.log(`Constructor skipped - empty update, keeping previous args`);
        }
    }

    chemical[$formula].refresh();
    return props;
}
Or simpler - just check the args directly:
typescript
if (this._bondConstructor && context.argsValid) {
    const newArgs = context.arguments.values;
    const hadArgs = this._lastAguments && this._lastAguments.values.length > 0;
    const hasArgs = newArgs.length > 0;
    
    // Skip if transitioning from "has args" to "no args"
    const shouldSkip = hadArgs && !hasArgs;
    
    if (!shouldSkip && (!this._lastAguments || !$BondArguments.equals(this._lastAguments, context.arguments))) {
        this._bondConstructor!.apply(this._chemical, newArgs);
        this._lastAguments = context.arguments;
    }
}

First, let me create a comprehensive example showing the pattern:
Perfect! I've created a comprehensive guide showing how to use styled-components with Chemistry. Here are the key patterns:
Pattern 1: Styled Components as Protected Properties
typescript
class $Card extends $Chemical {
    protected CardContainer = styled.div`
        padding: 20px;
        background: white;
    `;
    
    view() {
        const Container = this.CardContainer;
        return <Container>...</Container>;
    }
}
Pattern 2: Override in Subclasses
typescript
class $DarkCard extends $Card {
    // Just override what you want!
    protected CardContainer = styled.div`
        background: black;
    `;
}
Pattern 3: Methods for Dynamic Styles
typescript
protected getStyledButton() {
    return styled.button<{ $variant: string }>`
        background: ${props => props.$variant === 'primary' ? 'blue' : 'red'};
    `;
}
Why This Works Beautifully:
True Inheritance - Subclasses override just the styled components they want to change
No Wrapper Hell - No HOCs or render props needed
Type Safe - TypeScript knows about all your styled components
Clean Views - Extract to local variables for readable JSX
Reusability - Build libraries of styled components that can be extended
The demo shows working examples of cards, buttons, and books with interactive features. Click the books to see them open/close with smooth styled-components transitions!
This is the natural marriage of styled-components and OOP - styling becomes part of your class inheritance hierarchy! 🎨

Claude
16:25 UTC, 11 October 2025
The error is because you're passing props to styled-components that are meant for styling, not for the DOM. You need to prefix them with $ to tell styled-components they're transient props (styling-only, not DOM attributes).
Change this:
typescript
protected Number = styled.span<{ inLibrary: boolean }>`
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #666;
    min-width: ${props => props.inLibrary ? '20px' : '30px'};
`;
To this:
typescript
protected Number = styled.span<{ $inLibrary: boolean }>`
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #666;
    min-width: ${props => props.$inLibrary ? '20px' : '30px'};
`;
And when using it:
typescript
<Number $inLibrary={inLibrary}>{this.$number}.</Number>
Do this for ALL styled-components that receive props:
Container - change inLibrary to $inLibrary
Number - change inLibrary to $inLibrary
Pages - change inLibrary to $inLibrary
Container in $Cover - change color to $color
LibraryBookContainer in $Book - already has $isOpen ✓
The $ prefix tells styled-components: "this is a transient prop for styling only, don't pass it to the DOM element."

Claude
16:26 UTC, 11 October 2025
No, it's actually a styled-components convention! The $ prefix is their way of saying "transient prop - for styling only, don't pass to DOM."
Why styled-components can't take regular props:
When you write:
typescript
<MyStyledDiv color="blue">
Styled-components passes ALL props to the underlying DOM element. So React sees:
html
<div color="blue">  <!-- ❌ 'color' is not a valid HTML attribute -->
And React throws a warning because color isn't a valid HTML/SVG attribute.
The solution - transient props with ␀0␀:
typescript
const MyDiv = styled.div<{ $color: string }>`
  background: ${props => props.$color};
`;

<MyDiv $color="blue" />  // ✅ styled-components strips the $ prop
Styled-components sees the $ and says: "This prop is for me (for styling), I won't pass it to the DOM."
The result:
html
<div style="background: blue;">  <!-- ✅ Clean, no invalid props -->
It's actually perfect for Chemistry! Both use $ as a prefix:
Chemistry: $ means "reactive prop or Chemical class"
styled-components: $ means "styling prop, don't pass to DOM"
They work together beautifully! Just remember: any prop you use in your styled-component's template literal needs the ␀0␀ prefix to avoid polluting the DOM.

Claude
16:28 UTC, 11 October 2025
You have a circular reference loop! Look at the stack trace:
text
Catalogue.library → Library.catalogue → Catalogue.library → Library.catalogue ...
The problem is in your symbolize() function. When it tries to serialize the state, it's following these circular references infinitely:
$Catalogue has a getter get library() that returns its parent
$Library has catalogue property that references the $Catalogue
When symbolize() tries to serialize the catalogue's state, it accesses library
Which accesses the parent Library's catalogue property
Which goes back to the Catalogue... infinite loop!
The fix: Make library a non-reactive property by prefixing it with _:
typescript
export class $Catalogue extends $Chemical {
    references: $Reference[] = [];
    $filterCategory = 'all';
    
    // Use _ prefix to make it non-reactive
    get _library() { return this.parent as $Library; }
    
    $Catalogue() {
        // Use _library instead of library
        if (this._library && this._library.books) {
            const existingRefs = new Map(
                this.references.map(ref => [ref.book, ref])
            );
            
            this.references = this._library.books.map(book => {
                // ... rest of code
            });
        }
    }
}
The _ prefix tells Chemistry: "This is private/internal, don't track it for reactivity."
Alternatively, you could use the @inert() decorator:
typescript
@inert()
get library() { return this.parent as $Library; }
But the _ prefix is simpler and more conventional!

Claude
18:32 UTC, 13 October 2025
You're absolutely right! The symbolize() function should already handle this because it converts $Chemical instances to their cid. Let me look at your symbolize() function:
typescript
function symbolize(value: any): string {
    return stringify(value, function(this: any, key: string, val: any): any {
        if (key === '') return val;
        if (val instanceof $Chemical) return val[$cid];  // ← Should prevent loops!
        if (this instanceof $Chemical) return this[$cid];
        if (typeof val === 'function') return undefined;
        if (val?.constructor?.name === 'Proxy') return '[Proxy]';
        return val;
    });
}
The issue is that when bondGet() is called, it's accessing properties to symbolize them, which triggers getters, which are themselves bonds that call bondGet() again!
Look at the sequence:
bondGet() for catalogue property
Calls symbolize(value) on the catalogue
symbolize needs to serialize the catalogue object
It accesses catalogue.library (the getter)
The getter is a bond, so it calls bondGet()
bondGet() for library calls symbolize() on the parent Library
symbolize() accesses library.catalogue
Loop!
The real fix: Don't symbolize the value if it's a $Chemical in bondGet():
typescript
private bondGet() {
    const state = this._chemical[$state];
    let value = this._getter ? this._getter() : this._backingField;
    if (value instanceof $Chemical && value[$destroyed]) {
        if (this._setter) this._setter(value);
        return undefined;
    }
    if (this._chemical[$reactive]) {
        if (value instanceof $Chemical)
            this.bondForm(value);

        else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
            value.forEach(item => { 
                if (item instanceof $Chemical) 
                    this.bondForm(item);
            });
        }
        if (this.reactive && state) {
            // Don't call symbolize during bondGet - it triggers infinite loops!
            // Just store the cid directly for Chemicals
            if (value instanceof $Chemical) {
                state[this.bid] = value[$cid];
            } else {
                state[this.bid] = symbolize(value);
            }
        }
    }

    return value;
}
This way, when storing a Chemical in state, you just store its cid directly without calling symbolize(), which prevents the infinite loop of getter calls.

export class $Book extends $Chemical {
    $author = 'Unknown Author';
    cover?: $Cover;
    title?: $Title;
    chapters: $Chapter[] = [];
    
    // Polymorphic constructor - accepts different combinations
    $Book(first?: $Cover | $Title, ...rest: ($Title | $Chapter)[]) {
        // Handle different argument patterns
        if (first instanceof $Cover) {
            this.cover = first;
            this.title = rest[0] instanceof $Title ? rest[0] as $Title : undefined;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
        } else if (first instanceof $Title) {
            this.title = first;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
        } else {
            // No arguments - keep existing state
        }
    }
    
    view() {
        // Render differently based on parent
        const inLibrary = this.parent && this.parent.constructor.name === '$Library';
        
        if (inLibrary) {

                            {this.chapters.length} chapters
                        </div>

                </div>

            // Standalone detailed view
            return (
                <div style={{ 
                    border: '2px solid #333',

                    padding: '15px',
                    background: '#fff'
                }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '15px', marginBottom: '15px' }}>
                        {this.cover && (() => {
                            const [Cover, key] = $use(this.cover, 'key');
                            return <Cover key={key} />;
                        })()}

                            {this.title && (() => {
                                const [Title, key] = $use(this.title, 'key');
                                return <Title key={key} />;

                                return <Chapter key={key} />;
                            })}
                        </div>

            );
        }
    }
}

export class $Catalogue extends $Chemical {
    references: $Reference[] = [];
    $filterCategory = 'all';
    
    get library() { return this.parent as $Library; }
    
    $Catalogue() {
        // Dynamically create references from parent library's books
        if (this.library && this.library.books) {
            // Keep existing references for books that still exist
            const existingRefs = new Map(
                this.references.map(ref => [ref.book, ref])
            );
            
            this.references = this.library.books.map(book => {
                // Reuse existing reference if available
                if (existingRefs.has(book)) {
                    return existingRefs.get(book)!;
                }
                // Create new reference
                const ref = new $Reference();
                ref.book = book;
                ref.$category = book.chapters.length > 3 ? 'extensive' : 'brief';
                return ref;
            });
        }
    }
    
    view() {
        const filtered = this.$filterCategory === 'all' 
            ? this.references 
            : this.references.filter(r => r.$category === this.$filterCategory);
        
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '15px',
                background: '#fff',
                border: '2px solid #2196f3',
                borderRadius: '8px'
            }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '16px' }}>
                    📚 Reading Catalogue
                </h3>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#666', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                    {this.references.length} references from library
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '10px' }}>
                    {filtered.map(ref => {
                        const [Ref, key] = $use(ref, 'key');
                        return <Ref key={key} />;
                    })}
                </div>
                {filtered.length === 0 && (
                    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#999', padding: '20px' }}>
                        No references match filter
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Library extends $Chemical {
    books: $Book[] = [];
    catalogue?: $Catalogue;
    
    $Library(...children: ($Book | $Catalogue)[]) {
        this.books = children.filter(c => c instanceof $Book) as $Book[];
        this.catalogue = children.find(c => c instanceof $Catalogue) as $Catalogue;
    }
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ padding: '20px', background: '#f5f5f5', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 15px 0' }}>📖 Library</h2>
                <div style={{ marginBottom: '15px' }}>
                    <strong>Books in Library ({this.books.length}):</strong>
                    <div style={{ 
                        display: 'grid', 
                        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))',
                        gap: '10px',
                        marginTop: '10px'
                    }}>
                        {this.books.map(book => {
                            const [Book, key] = $use(book, 'key');
                            return <Book key={key} />;
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {this.catalogue && (() => {
                    const [Catalogue, key] = $use(this.catalogue, 'key');
                    return <Catalogue key={key} />;
                })()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

                ✓ Book detects parent type<br/>
                ✓ Renders compact in Library<br/>
                ✓ Renders detailed standalone
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// Test 4: Dynamic Object Graph (Catalogue)
function Test4DynamicObjectGraph() {
    const [bookCount, setBookCount] = useState(3);
    const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState<'all' | 'extensive' | 'brief'>('all');
    
    const books = Array.from({ length: bookCount }, (_, i) => {
        const chapters = i % 2 === 0 ? 5 : 2; // Alternating extensive/brief
        return (
            <Book key={i} author={`Author ${i + 1}`}>
                <Cover color={`hsl(${i * 60}, 70%, 60%)`} />
                <Title text={`Book ${i + 1}`} />
                {Array.from({ length: chapters }, (_, j) => (
                    <Chapter 
                        key={j}
                        number={j + 1} 
                        title={`Ch ${j + 1}`} 
                        pages={10} 
                    />
                ))}
            </Book>
        );
    });
    
    return (
        <div style={{ border: '2px solid green', padding: '15px', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
            <h4>Test 4: Dynamic Object Graph (Catalogue)</h4>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                Catalogue dynamically creates references from Library books
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setBookCount(Math.max(1, bookCount - 1))} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Remove Book
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setBookCount(bookCount + 1)} style={{ marginRight: '10px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Add Book
                </button>
                <select 
                    value={filterCategory} 
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterCategory(e.target.value as any)}
                    style={{ padding: '5px' }}
                >
                    <option value="all">All Categories</option>
                    <option value="extensive">Extensive (5+ chapters)</option>
                    <option value="brief">Brief (2 chapters)</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            
            <Library>
                {books}
                <Catalogue filterCategory={filterCategory} />
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Catalogue accesses parent Library<br/>
                ✓ Creates references dynamically<br/>
                ✓ Updates when books change<br/>
                ✓ Maintains reference state
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array
function Test5MixedPolymorphicArray() {
    const [mode, setMode] = useState<'minimal' | 'full' | 'mixed'>('mixed');
    
    const getBookContent = (index: number) => {
        if (mode === 'minimal') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Only Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        } else if (mode === 'full') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Cover color={`hsl(${index * 90}, 60%, 50%)`} />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} subtitle="Complete Edition" />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Part 1" pages={15} />
                    <Chapter number={2} title="Part 2" pages={20} />
                    <Chapter number={3} title="Part 3" pages={18} />
                </>
            );
        } else { // mixed
            return index % 2 === 0 ? (
                <>
                    <Cover color="#e91e63" />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={15} />
                </>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        }
    };
    
    return (
        <div style={{ border: '2px solid red', padding: '15px', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
            <h4>Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array</h4>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                Books in array change polymorphically (with/without Cover)
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('minimal')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Minimal
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('full')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Full
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('mixed')} style={{ padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Mixed
                </button>
            </div>
            
            <Library>
                {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
                    <Book key={i} author={`Author ${i + 1}`}>
                        {getBookContent(i)}
                    </Book>
                ))}
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Array elements change shape<br/>
                ✓ Some have Cover, some don't<br/>
                ✓ Constructor handles all variations<br/>
                ✓ Library displays all correctly
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// app/tests/dynamic-children/page.tsx
'use client'
import { $Chemical, $, $use } from '@/chemistry';
import React, { useState } from 'react';

// ============================================
// LIBRARY DOMAIN MODEL
// ============================================

export class $Cover extends $Chemical {
    $imageUrl?: string;
    $color = '#4a90e2';
    $title = 'Untitled';
    $author = 'Unknown';
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                width: '100%', 
                height: '100%', 
                background: this.$imageUrl 
                    ? `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.3), rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), url(${this.$imageUrl})`
                    : `linear-gradient(135deg, ${this.$color}, ${this.darken(this.$color, 0.3)})`,
                backgroundSize: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '15px',
                color: 'white',
                boxShadow: '0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s',
                position: 'relative',
                overflow: 'hidden'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-4px)';
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 8px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
            }}>
                {/* Decorative book spine effect */}
                <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    left: 0,
                    top: 0,
                    bottom: 0,
                    width: '6px',
                    background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.3), rgba(255,255,255,0.1))',
                    boxShadow: '2px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                }} />
                
                {/* Title area */}
                <div>
                    <div style={{ 
                        fontSize: '18px', 
                        fontWeight: 'bold',
                        textShadow: '2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
                        lineHeight: '1.2',
                        marginBottom: '8px'
                    }}>
                        {this.$title}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ 
                        fontSize: '13px',
                        opacity: 0.9,
                        textShadow: '1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
                    }}>
                        {this.$author}
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                {/* Decorative corner */}
                <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: '10px',
                    right: '10px',
                    opacity: 0.3,
                    fontSize: '24px'
                }}>
                    📖
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }
    
    private darken(color: string, amount: number): string {
        // Simple color darkening
        return color + Math.floor(amount * 100).toString(16);
    }
}

export class $Title extends $Chemical {
    $text = 'Untitled';
    $subtitle?: string;
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: '14px' }}>{this.$text}</div>
                {this.$subtitle && <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>{this.$subtitle}</div>}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Chapter extends $Chemical {
    $number = 1;
    $title = 'Chapter';
    $pages = 10;
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '4px 8px', 
                background: '#f5f5f5', 
                borderRadius: '3px',
                fontSize: '11px',
                marginBottom: '2px'
            }}>
                {this.$number}. {this.$title} ({this.$pages}p)
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Book extends $Chemical {
    $author = 'Unknown Author';
    cover?: $Cover;
    title?: $Title;
    chapters: $Chapter[] = [];
    
    // Polymorphic constructor - accepts different combinations
    $Book(first?: $Cover | $Title, ...rest: ($Title | $Chapter)[]) {
        // Handle different argument patterns
        if (first instanceof $Cover) {
            this.cover = first;
            this.title = rest[0] instanceof $Title ? rest[0] as $Title : undefined;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
        } else if (first instanceof $Title) {
            this.title = first;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
        } else {
            // No arguments - keep existing state
        }
    }
    
    view() {
        // Render differently based on parent
        const inLibrary = this.parent && this.parent.constructor.name === '$Library';
        
        if (inLibrary) {
            // Compact library view
            return (
                <div style={{ 
                    display: 'flex', 
                    gap: '10px', 
                    padding: '10px',
                    border: '1px solid #ddd',
                    borderRadius: '4px',
                    background: '#fff'
                }}>
                    {this.cover && (() => {
                        const [Cover, key] = $use(this.cover, 'key');
                        return <Cover key={key} />;
                    })()}
                    <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                        {this.title && (() => {
                            const [Title, key] = $use(this.title, 'key');
                            return <Title key={key} />;
                        })()}
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#666', marginTop: '4px' }}>
                            by {this.$author}
                        </div>
                        <div style={{ fontSize: '10px', color: '#999', marginTop: '2px' }}>
                            {this.chapters.length} chapters
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            // Standalone detailed view
            return (
                <div style={{ 
                    border: '2px solid #333',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    padding: '15px',
                    background: '#fff'
                }}>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '15px', marginBottom: '15px' }}>
                        {this.cover && (() => {
                            const [Cover, key] = $use(this.cover, 'key');
                            return <Cover key={key} />;
                        })()}
                        <div>
                            {this.title && (() => {
                                const [Title, key] = $use(this.title, 'key');
                                return <Title key={key} />;
                            })()}
                            <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#666', marginTop: '5px' }}>
                                by {this.$author}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <strong style={{ fontSize: '12px' }}>Chapters ({this.chapters.length}):</strong>
                        <div style={{ marginTop: '5px' }}>
                            {this.chapters.map(ch => {
                                const [Chapter, key] = $use(ch, 'key');
                                return <Chapter key={key} />;
                            })}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        }
    }
}

export class $Reference extends $Chemical {
    book?: $Book;
    $notes = '';
    $category = 'general';
    
    $Reference(book: $Book) {
        this.book = book;
    }
    
    view() {
        if (!this.book) return null;
        
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '8px',
                background: '#f9f9f9',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                fontSize: '11px'
            }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                    {this.book.title?.$text || 'Unknown'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ color: '#666', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                    {this.book.$author} • {this.book.chapters.length} chapters
                </div>
                {this.$notes && (
                    <div style={{ 
                        marginTop: '4px', 
                        padding: '4px', 
                        background: '#fff',
                        borderRadius: '2px',
                        fontSize: '10px'
                    }}>
                        📝 {this.$notes}
                    </div>
                )}
                <div style={{ 
                    marginTop: '4px',
                    padding: '2px 6px',
                    background: '#e3f2fd',
                    borderRadius: '2px',
                    display: 'inline-block',
                    fontSize: '9px'
                }}>
                    {this.$category}
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Catalogue extends $Chemical {
    references: $Reference[] = [];
    $filterCategory = 'all';
    
    get library() { return this.parent as $Library; }
    
    $Catalogue() {
        // Dynamically create references from parent library's books
        if (this.library && this.library.books) {
            // Keep existing references for books that still exist
            const existingRefs = new Map(
                this.references.map(ref => [ref.book, ref])
            );
            
            this.references = this.library.books.map(book => {
                // Reuse existing reference if available
                if (existingRefs.has(book)) {
                    return existingRefs.get(book)!;
                }
                // Create new reference
                const ref = new $Reference();
                ref.book = book;
                ref.$category = book.chapters.length > 3 ? 'extensive' : 'brief';
                return ref;
            });
        }
    }
    
    view() {
        const filtered = this.$filterCategory === 'all' 
            ? this.references 
            : this.references.filter(r => r.$category === this.$filterCategory);
        
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '15px',
                background: '#fff',
                border: '2px solid #2196f3',
                borderRadius: '8px'
            }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '16px' }}>
                    📚 Reading Catalogue
                </h3>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#666', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                    {this.references.length} references from library
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '10px' }}>
                    {filtered.map(ref => {
                        const [Ref, key] = $use(ref, 'key');
                        return <Ref key={key} />;
                    })}
                </div>
                {filtered.length === 0 && (
                    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#999', padding: '20px' }}>
                        No references match filter
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Library extends $Chemical {
    books: $Book[] = [];
    catalogue?: $Catalogue;
    
    $Library(...children: ($Book | $Catalogue)[]) {
        this.books = children.filter(c => c instanceof $Book) as $Book[];
        this.catalogue = children.find(c => c instanceof $Catalogue) as $Catalogue;
    }
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ padding: '20px', background: '#f5f5f5', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 15px 0' }}>📖 Library</h2>
                <div style={{ marginBottom: '15px' }}>
                    <strong>Books in Library ({this.books.length}):</strong>
                    <div style={{ 
                        display: 'grid', 
                        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))',
                        gap: '10px',
                        marginTop: '10px'
                    }}>
                        {this.books.map(book => {
                            const [Book, key] = $use(book, 'key');
                            return <Book key={key} />;
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {this.catalogue && (() => {
                    const [Catalogue, key] = $use(this.catalogue, 'key');
                    return <Catalogue key={key} />;
                })()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

                {books}
                <Catalogue filterCategory={filterCategory} />
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Catalogue accesses parent Library<br/>
                ✓ Creates references dynamically<br/>
                ✓ Updates when books change<br/>
                ✓ Maintains reference state
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array
function Test5MixedPolymorphicArray() {
    const [mode, setMode] = useState<'minimal' | 'full' | 'mixed'>('mixed');
    
    const getBookContent = (index: number) => {
        if (mode === 'minimal') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Only Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        } else if (mode === 'full') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Cover color={`hsl(${index * 90}, 60%, 50%)`} />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} subtitle="Complete Edition" />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Part 1" pages={15} />
                    <Chapter number={2} title="Part 2" pages={20} />
                    <Chapter number={3} title="Part 3" pages={18} />
                </>
            );
        } else { // mixed
            return index % 2 === 0 ? (
                <>
                    <Cover color="#e91e63" />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={15} />
                </>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        }
    };
    
    return (
        <div style={{ border: '2px solid red', padding: '15px', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
            <h4>Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array</h4>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                Books in array change polymorphically (with/without Cover)
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('minimal')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Minimal
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('full')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Full
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('mixed')} style={{ padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Mixed
                </button>
            </div>
            
            <Library>
                {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
                    <Book key={i} author={`Author ${i + 1}`}>
                        {getBookContent(i)}
                    </Book>
                ))}
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Array elements change shape<br/>
                ✓ Some have Cover, some don't<br/>
                ✓ Constructor handles all variations<br/>
                ✓ Library displays all correctly
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// app/tests/dynamic-children/page.tsx
'use client'
import { $Chemical, $, $use } from '@/chemistry';
import React, { useState } from 'react';

// ============================================
// LIBRARY DOMAIN MODEL

export class $Cover extends $Chemical {
    $imageUrl?: string;
    $color = '#4a90e2';
    $title = 'Untitled';
    $author = 'Unknown';
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                width: '100%', 
                height: '100%', 
                background: this.$imageUrl 
                    ? `linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.3), rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), url(${this.$imageUrl})`
                    : `linear-gradient(135deg, ${this.$color}, ${this.darken(this.$color, 0.3)})`,
                backgroundSize: 'cover',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '15px',
                color: 'white',
                boxShadow: '0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                transition: 'transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s',
                position: 'relative',
                overflow: 'hidden'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-4px)';
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 8px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';
            }}>
                {/* Decorative book spine effect */}
                <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    left: 0,
                    top: 0,
                    bottom: 0,
                    width: '6px',
                    background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.3), rgba(255,255,255,0.1))',
                    boxShadow: '2px 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                }} />
                
                {/* Title area */}
                <div>
                    <div style={{ 
                        fontSize: '18px', 
                        fontWeight: 'bold',
                        textShadow: '2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)',
                        lineHeight: '1.2',
                        marginBottom: '8px'
                    }}>
                        {this.$title}
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ 
                        fontSize: '13px',
                        opacity: 0.9,
                        textShadow: '1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
                    }}>
                        {this.$author}
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                {/* Decorative corner */}
                <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: '10px',
                    right: '10px',
                    opacity: 0.3,
                    fontSize: '24px'
                }}>
                    📖
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }
    
    private darken(color: string, amount: number): string {
        // Simple color darkening
        return color + Math.floor(amount * 100).toString(16);
    }
}

export class $Title extends $Chemical {
    $text = 'Untitled';
    $subtitle?: string;
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold', fontSize: '14px' }}>{this.$text}</div>
                {this.$subtitle && <div style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>{this.$subtitle}</div>}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Chapter extends $Chemical {
    $number = 1;
    $title = 'Chapter';
    $pages = 10;
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '4px 8px', 
                background: '#f5f5f5', 
                borderRadius: '3px',
                fontSize: '11px',
                marginBottom: '2px'
            }}>
                {this.$number}. {this.$title} ({this.$pages}p)
            </div>
        );

}

export class $Book extends $Chemical {
    $author = 'Unknown Author';
    cover?: $Cover;
    title?: $Title;
    chapters: $Chapter[] = [];
    
    // Internal state for the book view
    private _isOpen = false;
    
    // Polymorphic constructor - accepts different combinations
    $Book(first?: $Cover | $Title, ...rest: ($Title | $Chapter)[]) {
        // Handle different argument patterns
        if (first instanceof $Cover) {
            this.cover = first;
            this.title = rest[0] instanceof $Title ? rest[0] as $Title : undefined;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
            
            // Update cover with book info
            if (this.cover && this.title) {
                this.cover.$title = this.title.$text;
                this.cover.$author = this.$author;
            }
        } else if (first instanceof $Title) {
            this.title = first;
            this.chapters = rest.filter(r => r instanceof $Chapter) as $Chapter[];
        } else {
            // No arguments - keep existing state
        }
    }
    
    $toggleOpen() {
        this._isOpen = !this._isOpen;
    }
    
    view() {
        // Render differently based on parent
        const inLibrary = this.parent && this.parent.constructor.name === '$Library';
        
        if (inLibrary) {
            // Library shelf view - compact, spine-like
            return (
                <div 
                    onClick={this.$toggleOpen}
                    style={{ 
                        width: '180px',
                        height: this._isOpen ? 'auto' : '240px',
                        background: '#fff',
                        borderRadius: '8px',
                        boxShadow: '0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)',
                        overflow: 'hidden',
                        transition: 'all 0.3s ease',
                        cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}>
                    {!this._isOpen ? (
                        // Closed - show cover
                        this.cover && (() => {
                            const [Cover, key] = $use(this.cover, 'key');
                            return (
                                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
                                    <Cover key={key} />
                                </div>
                            );
                        })()
                    ) : (
                        // Open - show contents
                        <div style={{ padding: '15px' }}>
                            {/* Back button */}
                            <div style={{ 
                                display: 'flex', 
                                alignItems: 'center', 
                                gap: '8px',
                                marginBottom: '12px',
                                color: '#666',
                                fontSize: '12px',
                                cursor: 'pointer'
                            }}>
                                <span>← Back to cover</span>
                            </div>
                            
                            {/* Title page */}
                            <div style={{ 
                                borderBottom: '2px solid #eee',
                                paddingBottom: '12px',
                                marginBottom: '12px'
                            }}>
                                {this.title && (() => {
                                    const [Title, key] = $use(this.title, 'key');
                                    return <Title key={key} />;
                                })()}
                                <div style={{ 
                                    fontSize: '11px', 
                                    color: '#666',
                                    fontStyle: 'italic',
                                    marginTop: '4px'
                                }}>
                                    by {this.$author}
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            {/* Table of contents */}
                            <div>
                                <div style={{ 
                                    fontSize: '11px', 
                                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                                    color: '#888',
                                    marginBottom: '8px',
                                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                                    letterSpacing: '0.5px'
                                }}>
                                    Contents
                                </div>
                                {this.chapters.map(ch => {
                                    const [Chapter, key] = $use(ch, 'key');
                                    return <Chapter key={key} />;
                                })}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                </div>
            );
        } else {
            // Standalone detailed view - like a book on a table
            return (
                <div style={{ 
                    maxWidth: '500px',
                    background: '#fff',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    boxShadow: '0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)',
                    overflow: 'hidden'
                }}>
                    {/* Cover section */}
                    <div style={{ 
                        height: '300px',
                        position: 'relative'
                    }}>
                        {this.cover && (() => {
                            const [Cover, key] = $use(this.cover, 'key');
                            return (
                                <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
                                    <Cover key={key} />
                                </div>
                            );
                        })()}
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Content section */}
                    <div style={{ padding: '24px' }}>
                        {/* Title */}
                        <div style={{ marginBottom: '16px' }}>
                            {this.title && (() => {
                                const [Title, key] = $use(this.title, 'key');
                                return <Title key={key} />;
                            })()}
                            <div style={{ 
                                fontSize: '14px', 
                                color: '#666',
                                marginTop: '8px'
                            }}>
                                by {this.$author}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        {/* Chapters */}
                        <div style={{
                            borderTop: '1px solid #eee',
                            paddingTop: '16px'
                        }}>
                            <div style={{ 
                                fontSize: '13px',
                                fontWeight: 'bold',
                                color: '#888',
                                marginBottom: '12px',
                                textTransform: 'uppercase',
                                letterSpacing: '0.5px'
                            }}>
                                Table of Contents
                            </div>
                            <div style={{ 
                                display: 'flex',
                                flexDirection: 'column',
                                gap: '6px'
                            }}>
                                {this.chapters.map(ch => {
                                    const [Chapter, key] = $use(ch, 'key');
                                    return <Chapter key={key} />;
                                })}
                            </div>
                            {this.chapters.length === 0 && (
                                <div style={{ 
                                    color: '#999',
                                    fontSize: '12px',
                                    fontStyle: 'italic',
                                    textAlign: 'center',
                                    padding: '20px'
                                }}>
                                    No chapters yet
                                </div>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        }
    }
}

export class $Reference extends $Chemical {
    book?: $Book;
    $notes = '';
    $category = 'general';
    
    $Reference(book: $Book) {
        this.book = book;
    }
    
    view() {
        if (!this.book) return null;
        
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '8px',
                background: '#f9f9f9',
                borderRadius: '4px',
                border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                fontSize: '11px'
            }}>
                <div style={{ fontWeight: 'bold' }}>
                    {this.book.title?.$text || 'Unknown'}
                </div>
                <div style={{ color: '#666', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                    {this.book.$author} • {this.book.chapters.length} chapters
                </div>
                {this.$notes && (
                    <div style={{ 
                        marginTop: '4px', 
                        padding: '4px', 
                        background: '#fff',

                    }}>

                    </div>
                )}
                <div style={{

                    display: 'inline-block',

                }}>
                    {this.$category}
                </div>
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Catalogue extends $Chemical {
    references: $Reference[] = [];
    $filterCategory = 'all';
    
    get library() { return this.parent as $Library; }
    
    $Catalogue() {
        // Dynamically create references from parent library's books
        if (this.library && this.library.books) {
            // Keep existing references for books that still exist
            const existingRefs = new Map(
                this.references.map(ref => [ref.book, ref])
            );
            
            this.references = this.library.books.map(book => {
                // Reuse existing reference if available
                if (existingRefs.has(book)) {
                    return existingRefs.get(book)!;
                }
                // Create new reference
                const ref = new $Reference();
                ref.book = book;
                ref.$category = book.chapters.length > 3 ? 'extensive' : 'brief';
                return ref;
            });
        }
    }
    
    view() {
        const filtered = this.$filterCategory === 'all' 
            ? this.references 
            : this.references.filter(r => r.$category === this.$filterCategory);
        
        return (
            <div style={{ 
                padding: '15px',
                background: '#fff',
                border: '2px solid #2196f3',
                borderRadius: '8px'
            }}>
                <h3 style={{ margin: '0 0 10px 0', fontSize: '16px' }}>
                    📚 Reading Catalogue
                </h3>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '12px', color: '#666', marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                    {this.references.length} references from library
                </div>
                <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr))', gap: '10px' }}>
                    {filtered.map(ref => {
                        const [Ref, key] = $use(ref, 'key');
                        return <Ref key={key} />;
                    })}
                </div>
                {filtered.length === 0 && (
                    <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', color: '#999', padding: '20px' }}>
                        No references match filter
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

export class $Library extends $Chemical {
    books: $Book[] = [];
    catalogue?: $Catalogue;
    
    $Library(...children: ($Book | $Catalogue)[]) {
        this.books = children.filter(c => c instanceof $Book) as $Book[];
        this.catalogue = children.find(c => c instanceof $Catalogue) as $Catalogue;
    }
    
    view() {
        return (
            <div style={{ padding: '20px', background: '#f5f5f5', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
                <h2 style={{ margin: '0 0 15px 0' }}>📖 Library</h2>
                <div style={{ marginBottom: '15px' }}>
                    <strong>Books in Library ({this.books.length}):</strong>
                    <div style={{ 
                        display: 'grid', 
                        gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr))',
                        gap: '10px',
                        marginTop: '10px'
                    }}>
                        {this.books.map(book => {
                            const [Book, key] = $use(book, 'key');
                            return <Book key={key} />;
                        })}
                    </div>
                </div>
                {this.catalogue && (() => {
                    const [Catalogue, key] = $use(this.catalogue, 'key');
                    return <Catalogue key={key} />;
                })()}
            </div>
        );
    }
}

        <div style={{ border: '2px solid green', padding: '15px', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
            <h4>Test 4: Dynamic Object Graph (Catalogue)</h4>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                Catalogue dynamically creates references from Library books
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setBookCount(Math.max(1, bookCount - 1))} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Remove Book
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setBookCount(bookCount + 1)} style={{ marginRight: '10px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Add Book
                </button>
                <select 
                    value={filterCategory} 
                    onChange={(e) => setFilterCategory(e.target.value as any)}
                    style={{ padding: '5px' }}
                >
                    <option value="all">All Categories</option>
                    <option value="extensive">Extensive (5+ chapters)</option>
                    <option value="brief">Brief (2 chapters)</option>
                </select>
            </div>
            
            <Library>
                {books}
                <Catalogue filterCategory={filterCategory} />
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Catalogue accesses parent Library<br/>
                ✓ Creates references dynamically<br/>
                ✓ Updates when books change<br/>
                ✓ Maintains reference state
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array
function Test5MixedPolymorphicArray() {
    const [mode, setMode] = useState<'minimal' | 'full' | 'mixed'>('mixed');
    
    const getBookContent = (index: number) => {
        if (mode === 'minimal') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Only Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        } else if (mode === 'full') {
            return (
                <>
                    <Cover color={`hsl(${index * 90}, 60%, 50%)`} />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} subtitle="Complete Edition" />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Part 1" pages={15} />
                    <Chapter number={2} title="Part 2" pages={20} />
                    <Chapter number={3} title="Part 3" pages={18} />
                </>
            );
        } else { // mixed
            return index % 2 === 0 ? (
                <>
                    <Cover color="#e91e63" />
                    <Title text={`Full Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={15} />
                </>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <Title text={`Minimal Book ${index}`} />
                    <Chapter number={1} title="Chapter" pages={10} />
                </>
            );
        }
    };
    
    return (
        <div style={{ border: '2px solid red', padding: '15px', borderRadius: '8px' }}>
            <h4>Test 5: Mixed Polymorphic Array</h4>
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px', fontSize: '12px' }}>
                Books in array change polymorphically (with/without Cover)
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ marginBottom: '10px' }}>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('minimal')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Minimal
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('full')} style={{ marginRight: '5px', padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    All Full
                </button>
                <button onClick={() => setMode('mixed')} style={{ padding: '5px 10px' }}>
                    Mixed
                </button>
            </div>
            
            <Library>
                {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
                    <Book key={i} author={`Author ${i + 1}`}>
                        {getBookContent(i)}
                    </Book>
                ))}
            </Library>
            
            <div style={{ marginTop: '10px', fontSize: '11px', color: '#666' }}>
                ✓ Array elements change shape<br/>
                ✓ Some have Cover, some don't<br/>
                ✓ Constructor handles all variations<br/>
                ✓ Library displays all correctly
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

// app/tests/dynamic-children/page.tsx
'use client'
import { $Chemical, $, $use } from '@/chemistry';
import React, { useState } from 'react';

// ============================================
// LIBRARY DOMAIN MODEL
